trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the receipt for the other 54 trophies: it pops on its own the moment the last one lands, so there is no separate task to plan for. Work the roadmap in order — story first, the one missable meditation protected in Chapter 1, then the 100% checklist — and this unlocks last by itself. trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley by stealing all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling — a gang operation in Port Gellhorn — not by bowling a strike. Before going, buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation: you need them to blow the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, pick up the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, blown open with sticky bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. If you do not get all 3 in one go, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for the rest — it is not missable.

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength via Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, select a character and scroll to Strength (heart icon). trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on the notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): whenever you do something that affects your reputation you see a little demon face on the right of the screen. The profiles run Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them, e.g. shooting limbs), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence, which makes cops more aggressive, so avoid it. It will very likely come passively while you do all the other trophies and the 100% checklist; every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it is still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission with Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses); it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. To register 10 you must first buy enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds one or more parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray and Register. Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with Standard Trackers, and register them at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
